description: Implementation of the ProgramWorkflowService interface managing program workflows, states, and related entities within the OpenMRS platform. Provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting program-related data, including handling complex logic like state transitions and cascade delete operations.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the ProgramWorkflowService interface managing program workflows, states, and related entities within OpenMRS.

methods.name: saveProgram
methods.description: Validates and saves a Program entity with its associated workflows and states.

methods.name: getProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its ID.

methods.name: getProgramByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by its unique name, throwing exception if multiple matches are found.

methods.name: getAllPrograms
methods.description: Returns a list of all programs, including or excluding retired based on parameter.

methods.name: getPrograms
methods.description: Finds programs matching a name fragment.

methods.name: purgeProgram
methods.description: Deletes a program from the database, optionally cascading.

methods.name: retireProgram
methods.description: Marks a program and its workflows and states as retired.

methods.name: unretireProgram
methods.description: Unmarks a program and its associated entities as retired.

methods.name: savePatientProgram
methods.description: Saves a PatientProgram, ensuring state integrity and date consistency.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgram by its ID.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms
methods.description: Retrieves patient programs based on various filtering parameters.

methods.name: purgePatientProgram
methods.description: Deletes a PatientProgram from the database.

methods.name: voidPatientProgram
methods.description: Voids a PatientProgram and sets its reason.

methods.name: unvoidPatientProgram
methods.description: Unvoids a previously voided PatientProgram and related states.

methods.name: getPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Retrieves possible outcome concepts for a program.

methods.name: saveConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Saves a ConceptStateConversion entity after validation.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by its ID.

methods.name: getAllConceptStateConversions
methods.description: Returns all ConceptStateConversion entities.

methods.name: purgeConceptStateConversion
methods.description: Deletes a ConceptStateConversion.

methods.name: getConceptStateConversionByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptStateConversion by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByUuid
methods.description: Gets a PatientProgram using its UUID.

methods.name: getProgramByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Program by UUID.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by ID.

methods.name: getStateByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflowState by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientStateByUuid
methods.description: Gets a PatientState by UUID.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow by UUID.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowStatesByConcept
methods.description: Finds ProgramWorkflowStates associated with a given Concept.

methods.name: getProgramWorkflowsByConcept
methods.description: Finds ProgramWorkflows associated with a given Concept.

methods.name: getAllProgramAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all ProgramAttributeType entities.

methods.name: getProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramAttributeType by ID.

methods.name: getProgramAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves ProgramAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Saves a ProgramAttributeType entity.

methods.name: purgeProgramAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a ProgramAttributeType.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PatientProgramAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeByAttributeName
methods.description: Fetches patient program attributes by patient IDs and attribute name.

methods.name: getPatientProgramByAttributeNameAndValue
methods.description: Finds patient programs by attribute name and value.

methods.name: triggerStateConversion
methods.description: Converts patient states based on a trigger concept and date.
